subject: math
title: Units of length, mass, capacity and time

cards.front: How many millimetres are in 1 centimetre?
cards.say: How many millimetres are in one centimetre? Ten millimetres.

cards.front: How many millimetres are in 1 metre?
cards.say: How many millimetres are in one metre? One thousand millimetres.

cards.front: Change 3 km to metres.
cards.say: Change three kilometres to metres. Three thousand metres

cards.front: Change 4 m to centimetres.
cards.say: Change four metres to centimetres. Four hundred centimetres

cards.front: Change 6 cm to millimetres.
cards.say: Change six centimetres to millimetres. Sixty millimetres

cards.front: Change 80 mm to centimetres.
cards.say: Change eighty millimetres to centimetres. Eight centimetres

cards.front: Change 650 cm to metres.
cards.say: Change six hundred and fifty centimetres to metres. Six point five metres, which is six metres fifty centimetres.

cards.front: Change 2.5 km to metres.
cards.back:
2,500 m
2 × 1,000 = 2,000, and half a kilometre is 500.
cards.say: Change two point five kilometres to metres. Two thousand five hundred metres. Two times one thousand equals two thousand, and half a kilometre is five hundred.

cards.front: Change 3.5 kg to grams.
cards.say: Change three point five kilograms to grams. Three thousand five hundred grams

cards.front: Change 4,200 g to kilograms and grams.
cards.say: Change four thousand two hundred grams to kilograms and grams. Four kilograms two hundred grams

cards.front: Change 2.5 l to millilitres.
cards.say: Change two point five litres to millilitres. Two thousand five hundred millilitres

cards.front: Change 7,000 ml to litres.
cards.say: Change seven thousand millilitres to litres. Seven litres

cards.front: How many metres are in half a kilometre?
cards.say: How many metres are in half a kilometre? Five hundred metres

cards.front: How many millilitres are in a quarter of a litre?
cards.say: How many millilitres are in a quarter of a litre? Two hundred and fifty millilitres

cards.front: How many grams are in three quarters of a kilogram?
cards.say: How many grams are in three quarters of a kilogram? Seven hundred and fifty grams. One thousand divided by four equals two hundred and fifty, and three times two hundred and fifty equals seven hundred and fifty.

cards.front: Which is longer: 1,050 mm or 1 m?
cards.say: Which is longer: one thousand and fifty millimetres or one metre? One thousand and fifty millimetres, because one metre is one thousand millimetres.

cards.front: Put in order, shortest first: 1 m, 90 cm, 1,050 mm.
cards.back:
90 cm, 1 m, 1,050 mm
In millimetres: 900, 1,000 and 1,050.
cards.say: Put in order, shortest first: one metre, ninety centimetres, one thousand and fifty millimetres. Ninety centimetres, one metre, one thousand and fifty millimetres. In millimetres: nine hundred, one thousand and one thousand and fifty.

cards.front: How many seconds are in 4 minutes?
cards.say: How many seconds are in four minutes? Two hundred and forty seconds. Four times sixty equals two hundred and forty.

cards.front: How many minutes are in 3 hours?
cards.say: How many minutes are in three hours? One hundred and eighty minutes. Three times sixty equals one hundred and eighty.

cards.front: How many minutes are in 2.5 hours?
cards.back:
150 minutes
2 × 60 = 120, plus 30 for the half hour.
cards.say: How many minutes are in two point five hours? One hundred and fifty minutes. Two times sixty equals one hundred and twenty, plus thirty for the half hour.

cards.front: How many days are in 3 weeks?
cards.say: How many days are in three weeks? Twenty one days

cards.front: How many weeks are in 28 days?
cards.say: How many weeks are in twenty eight days? Four weeks

cards.front: How many days are in a leap year?
cards.back: 366 days. A normal year has 365 days.
cards.say: How many days are in a leap year? Three hundred and sixty six days. A normal year has three hundred and sixty five days.

cards.front: How many months are in 3 years?
cards.say: How many months are in three years? Thirty six months
